name: alpha-sweep
airframe: Fighter1, Multirole1, SmallFighter1, trainer, VTOLTrainer1, EW1, FastBomber1, Darkreach
note: THE highest-value card: aoaLimiterActivePct is 0 in every capture ever taken. Same stimulus shape as fixedwing-sweep (deriveAzRate = 0.6 of the airframe's own instantaneous rate, i.e. a fixed fraction of ITS structural g), flown at 8000 m instead of 4000. Thin air means that fraction is no longer available aerodynamically, so the wing rides its alpha ceiling and stays there as energy bleeds. Pass = aoaAboveCeilingPct > 0 on alphaHold; 0 means the card failed to reach the regime, not that the law is clean. AIRFRAME: the eight fixed-wing keys that clear the v0.92 envelope gate (1.10x Vstall .. 0.95x Vmax) at this card's 250 m/s - CAS1 (0.95x Vmax = 195.3), COIN (134.6) and all three rotorcraft would be refused pre-spawn. deriveAzRate makes the demand a fraction of EACH lane's own capability, so the eight are asking one question rather than eight, and the 5.0 gLimit airframes (FastBomber1, Darkreach) are the ones most likely to hit alpha before g - which is the regime this card exists to find. It does NOT cover the loaded case - a card cannot set a loadout - so fly it again by hand with heavy stores.
